# Third-party assets

Model/runtime sources and exact file hashes are in `public/models/provenance.json`; descriptions are in `docs/MODELS.md`. Copyright and license text downloaded from upstream accompanies this delivery. Model licensing can differ from example-wrapper licensing. No ownership of upstream models or libraries is claimed. The application team's original source ownership is unchanged.

The model installer uses pinned versions/commits. The Ultralytics AGPL text and MediaPipe master license were retrieved on 30 October 2026 for attribution; the model assets themselves remain pinned as documented. npm development dependencies are defined in package-lock.json and are not included as installed node_modules in the ZIP.
